text_block_list.text:
I've finally made it this far.
To the battlefield that will decide who is the "strongest."

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"...I truly feel it!
Hearing these cheers makes me realize to the core
that helping with this race was destiny!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Your partner is...
Ah! Already off to the battlefield!
I wanted to cheer them on, but I was a step too late!
choice_data_list: Thank you very much for your support.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! I am cheering for EVERY SINGLE Umamusume
competing in this race!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Win or lose, it all comes down to this fever-pitch climax—
And they're off!!

First, race number one.
The first step toward becoming the "strongest" starts here!
